categories.title: Start here
categories.intro:
Prefix is `!!` by default (admins can change it with `!!prefix`). Slash is experimental.
`!!help <word>` searches · `!!help economy` jumps to a page · buttons flip pages.
New? `!!tutorial` · Admins? `!!tutorial admin`

commands.name: !!tutorial
commands.description: Guided intro for new players, or `!!tutorial admin` for first-time server setup.

commands.name: !!help
commands.description: Command list by section, or search (e.g. !!help rob, !!help campaign).

commands.name: !!daily
commands.description: Claim your free coins for the day. Pick Safe, Lucky, or Gamble, hit streak milestones, and check `!!daily stats`.

commands.name: !!work
commands.description: Pick a shift and optional hustle check for coins. Career ladder still applies. `!!legacy-commands` switches to the classic one-message version.

commands.name: !!balance
commands.description: Shows your coin balance, or someone else's.

commands.name: !!invite
commands.description: Gets the link to add this bot to your own server.

commands.name: !!support
commands.description: Gets help, report a bug, or ask a question about the bot.

commands.name: !!changelog
commands.description: Shows what's new in the bot, one update per page, newest first.

commands.name: !!career
commands.description: Shows your job, your pay, and how close you are to a promotion. Every `!!work` counts.

commands.name: !!fish
commands.description: Pick a zone and follow the on-screen hook prompt for better rares. `!!legacy-commands` for the classic version.

commands.name: !!mine
commands.description: Pick a zone and follow the on-screen strike prompt for better rares. `!!legacy-commands` for the classic version.

commands.name: !!quests
commands.description: Shows your 3 daily and 2 weekly quests. Finished quests pay coins (weekly ones also give a Loot Box) when you check them.

commands.name: !!tribute
commands.description: Pay tribute to the Overlord (500 to 25,000 coins) and see how he feels: from disdain to blessings, curses, and rare jackpots. Every tribute also fills the shared treasury, and a full treasury earns the whole server a free decree. See `!!decree`.

commands.name: !!lottery
commands.description: A daily lottery with a shared pot. Tickets cost 50 each, and one winner is drawn at midnight UTC.

commands.name: !!vote
commands.description: Claim coins after voting for the bot on top.gg (plus a short earn buff).

commands.name: !!legacy-commands
commands.description: Toggle classic mode for !!work, !!rob, !!fish, and !!mine. When on, those commands use the old simple one-message versions with no menus or minigames.

commands.name: !!shop
commands.description: Browse the shop: supplies, gear upgrades, and titles. One item is 20% off every day!

commands.name: !!buy
commands.description: Buys something from the shop, like `!!buy padlock` or `!!buy lootbox 3`.

commands.name: !!sell
commands.description: Sells the fish and ore you found. `!!sell all` sells everything, or pick one like `!!sell carp 3`.

commands.name: !!inventory
commands.description: Shows your items, catch, gear, titles, and any boosts you have running.

commands.name: !!use
commands.description: Uses an item from your inventory: boosts, Loot Boxes (`!!use lootbox 3`), or equips a title.

commands.name: !!craft
commands.description: Craft food, tools, potions, and trinkets from fish, ore, and parts. `!!craft` lists recipes; `!!craft bait` makes one. Combat gear still uses `!!forge`.

commands.name: !!forge
commands.description: Forge weapons and armor from ore, coal, and boss drops. `!!forge` shows the recipes, `!!forge iron sword` crafts one, and `!!forge enchant fire` enchants your weapon.

commands.name: !!loadout
commands.description: Shows or changes your gear. Examples: `!!loadout weapon iron sword`, `!!loadout armor chain`, `!!loadout class mage`, `!!loadout item add potion`, `!!loadout title duelist`.

commands.name: !!pet
commands.usage: !!pet [adopt | feed [fish] | play | name <name> | release confirm | list | @user]
commands.description: Adopt a pet (1,500 coins) that gives you a small perk. Feed it fish from `!!fish` to level it up and evolve it at level 10, but a starving pet's perks switch off. `!!pet list` shows what you can get.

categories.title: Risk & theft
categories.intro: Rob, heist, bank, bounties. Protection items matter.

commands.name: !!rob
commands.description: Rob a player or NPC mark (methods, minigame, heat). `!!legacy-commands` uses the old simple !!rob @user roll.

commands.name: !!heist
commands.description: Plans a team heist. Others have 60 seconds to join. More crew means better odds, but the loot is shared and failure costs everyone a fine.

commands.name: !!bank
commands.description: Pocket vs bank. Deposit (1% fee). Withdraw up to 750/day free; larger amounts unlock after 3 hours. Weekly 1% bank upkeep. `!!bank heist @user` starts a long vault-heist minigame. Normal `!!rob` only hits pocket cash.

commands.name: !!bounty
commands.description: Overlord bounty (duel or rob to claim) and player-posted bounties. `!!bounty post @user <amount> [hours]` holds your coins as a reward; others claim by winning a duel vs the target or robbing enough from them.

commands.name: !!give
commands.description: Gives some of your coins to another member.

commands.name: !!trade
commands.description: Trade coins and items with another member in a safe, two-sided window. You can trade fish, ores, materials, supplies, and forged weapons or armor (not equipped gear).

commands.name: !!muscle
commands.description: Hire guards that make you harder to rob, or thieves that rob other players while you are offline. They cost daily upkeep.

commands.name: !!spy
commands.description: Pay 300 coins to send a spy and learn someone's wallet, guards, and thieves. Success also makes your next `!!rob` on them 10% more likely to work. Guards make spies easier to catch.

categories.title: Market
categories.intro: Stocks can crash. Don’t cry about it.

commands.name: !!stocks
commands.description: See the stock market. Prices update hourly. Add a symbol like `KRKN` for details, or `news` for headlines.

commands.name: !!invest
commands.description: Buy shares on the Realm Stock Exchange (1% fee). Large buys ask for confirmation. Bankrupt stocks can wipe your position.

commands.name: !!cashout
commands.description: Sell your shares for coins (1% fee). Leave the amount out to sell everything in that stock, or use `!!cashout all` to sell everything.

commands.name: !!portfolio
commands.description: See your stock investments, what they are worth, and your profit or loss.

commands.name: !!ipo
commands.description: Take your own company public on the stock market for 3000 coins. Its price follows how rich and active you are, and you earn its trading fees.

commands.name: !!project
commands.description: The whole server builds projects together with coins, fish, and ore. Finished projects give everyone a permanent perk.

categories.title: Games
categories.intro: Board and party games. Bets use server coins when enabled.

commands.name: !!tictactoe
commands.description: Challenges someone to tic-tac-toe, played with buttons. Optionally bet coins on it.

commands.name: !!connect4
commands.description: Challenges someone to Connect Four, played with column buttons. Optionally bet coins on it.

commands.name: !!battleship
commands.description: Plays Battleship. Challenge a friend (optionally with a coin bet), or leave out the player to play a solo practice round against me. You pick the board size (10×10 or 8×8), place your ships in secret, then take turns typing squares like `C4`.

commands.name: !!wordle
commands.description: Starts a Wordle for the whole channel. Type 5-letter words to guess. The solver wins coins, more for fewer guesses.

commands.name: !!hangman
commands.description: Guess the hidden word before the drawing is finished. Anyone in the channel can help, and whoever solves it wins 25 to 50 coins.

commands.name: !!minesweeper
commands.description: Reveal safe tiles on a grid and cash out before you hit a mine! More mines (2 to 10, default 4) means bigger payouts. Leave out the bet for a practice round.

commands.name: !!liarsdice
commands.description: Opens a lobby for Liar's Dice (2-5 players). Bluff about how many dice are on the table, or call someone a liar. The last player with dice wins, and everyone antes the bet.

commands.name: !!blackjack
commands.description: Plays blackjack against the dealer with hit and stand buttons. Blackjack pays 3:2. Leave out the bet for a practice round.

commands.name: !!higherlower
commands.description: Guess if the next card is higher or lower. Every correct guess raises your multiplier, so cash out before you slip! Leave out the bet for a practice round.

categories.title: Gambling
categories.intro: Pure chance. Admin can disable these in settings.

commands.name: !!slots
commands.description: Spins a slot machine. Three of a kind pays big, two of a kind returns your bet. Use `all` to bet everything.

commands.name: !!roulette
commands.description: Bet on the roulette wheel. The first bet opens a table for 20 seconds, and anyone in the channel can join before it spins. Colors, odd/even, and low/high pay 1:1, dozens pay 2:1, and a single number pays 35:1.

commands.name: !!crash
commands.description: A rocket multiplier climbs higher and higher. Cash out before it crashes! Leave out the bet for a practice round.

commands.name: !!gamble
commands.description: Double or nothing! Slightly under a 50% chance to win. Use `all` to bet everything.

commands.name: !!duel
commands.description: Challenges someone to a duel. Pick a class, then choose moves in secret each round. Your gear and battle items count! Add `ranked` for equal gear with no bets (the only mode that counts for the ladder), or `bo3` for best of 3.

commands.name: !!boss
commands.description: Checks if a raid boss is active. Bosses show up rarely while people chat, and everyone can fight them together.

commands.name: !!stats
commands.description: Shows a combat record: duel wins and losses, streaks, damage dealt, favorite move, boss kills, and titles.

commands.name: !!ranked
commands.description: Shows the ranked ladder for duels, Connect Four, and Battleship. Beat other players to climb. Seasons last a month and the top 3 win coins.

commands.name: !!tournament
commands.description: A weekly single-elimination bracket every Saturday at 18:00 UTC. Entry costs 200 coins, there are no gear or items, and the winner takes 70% of the prize pool.

commands.name: !!raid
commands.description: Raid a random server! A live battle channel opens in both servers — strike, ambush, brace, rally, taunt, spy, and mid-raid events. `!!raid rules` explains everything, `!!raid optout` removes you from raids.

commands.name: !!raid-config
commands.usage: !!raid-config [category <name or #category> | category reset | optout | optin | ping <role> | ping off]
commands.description: Admin settings for cross-server raids (needs Manage Server). Pick the category raid channels are created in, add a role to ping, or opt the whole server out of raids.

categories.title: Campaign
categories.intro: Global map: one house per server. New? Read `!!guide` first.

commands.name: !!guide
commands.description: How the World Campaign works, step by step.

commands.name: !!campaign
commands.description: World campaign overview. Slash: /campaign args: <action> (see !!guide).

commands.name: !!map
commands.description: Show the world map and refresh this server’s map message.

commands.name: !!me
commands.description: Your house’s cities, troops and treasury.

commands.name: !!province
commands.description: One province: cities, owners, borders and troops.

commands.name: !!houses
commands.description: Ranking of every house (server) on the map.

commands.name: !!recruit
commands.description: Claim or reinforce ONE city with troops (costs coins).

commands.name: !!move
commands.description: Move troops between neighboring provinces (next turn).

commands.name: !!attack
commands.description: Siege the first open city in a neighboring province.

commands.name: !!siege
commands.description: Siege one specific city (next turn).

commands.name: !!invade
commands.description: Landless houses only: gain a foothold by force (costs coins).

commands.name: !!fortify
commands.description: Make a city you own harder to siege.

commands.name: !!collect
commands.description: Take your cities’ tax as coins.

commands.name: !!ally
commands.description: Seasonal alliance with another server.

commands.name: !!unally
commands.description: Break your alliance.

commands.name: !!housecolor
commands.description: Recolor your house on the map.

commands.name: !!orders
commands.description: Your queued moves and sieges.

commands.name: !!cancelorders
commands.description: Cancel all your queued orders.

commands.name: !!mapchannel
commands.description: Pick where the live map is posted (Manage Server).

categories.title: Realm & seasons
categories.intro: Shared world flavor and competition between servers.

commands.name: !!gazette
commands.description: Shows the latest Overlord's Gazette (newspaper image + caption).

commands.name: !!forecast
commands.description: See the current weather and what is coming next. Weather changes fishing, mining, and robberies.

commands.name: !!event
commands.description: Shows the server events happening right now. Events start every day or so, with boosted fishing, XP, sales, and more, plus a limited-time shop title.

commands.name: !!decree
commands.description: Shows the Overlord's active decrees and how full the tribute treasury is. Fill it with `!!tribute` to earn a free decree for everyone.

commands.name: !!rebellion
commands.description: Shows the Rebellion meter. Everyone running commands and fighting bosses fills it. When it's full, the Overlord himself descends, and whoever lands the final blow becomes the Usurper.

commands.name: !!usurper
commands.description: Shows who holds the throne. The Usurper can command one decree per reign and collect a royal stipend every 2 hours. Anyone can challenge them with `!!usurper challenge` (best of 3, equal gear).

commands.name: !!war
commands.description: The weekly Server War: servers compete on how much profit their top players make. Admins can opt this server out with `!!war leave` and back in with `!!war join`.

commands.name: !!board
commands.description: Today in the Realm — weather, decrees, bounty, throne, market, and recent headlines. Optional living board: !!settings board #channel

commands.name: !!economy
commands.description: Shows this server’s economy mode and realm treasury. Admins can switch `classic` (default, open minting) or `scarce` (wages paid from the treasury, wealth tax).

commands.name: !!profile
commands.description: Shows a full profile card: level, coins, career, gear, pet, combat record, and ranked ratings.

commands.name: !!rank
commands.description: Shows your level, XP progress, prestige, and title. You earn XP by chatting.

commands.name: !!leaderboard
commands.description: Shows this server's richest members and top chatters side by side.

commands.name: !!globalleaderboard
commands.description: Shows the richest and most active players across every server, with each player's servers added together.

commands.name: !!prestige
commands.description: Reset your level for a permanent +5% coin bonus, a badge, and a coin reward. Needs level 20 (then 25, 30...). Up to 10 times.

commands.name: !!optout
commands.description: Opt out of the bot in this server (deletes your data here).

commands.name: !!optin
commands.description: Opt back into the bot after !!optout (fresh start in this server).

commands.name: !!webhide
commands.description: Hides you from the public website leaderboards (`on`), or shows you again (`off`). With no option it flips your current choice.

categories.title: Moderation
categories.intro: Prefix-only. You need the matching Discord permission or the server’s moderator role (`!!modrole`).

commands.name: !!warn
commands.description: Warn a member. Warnings stack and can trigger automatic actions.

commands.name: !!warnings
commands.description: List active warnings (yours, or anyone’s if you’re a moderator).

commands.name: !!delwarn
commands.description: Remove one warning by its case number.

commands.name: !!clearwarns
commands.description: Remove ALL active warnings from someone.

commands.name: !!note
commands.description: Add a private moderator note (shows in !!history, never counts as a warning).

commands.name: !!mute
commands.description: Time a member out (10m, 2h, 3d... max 28d, default 1h).

commands.name: !!unmute
commands.description: End a timeout early.

commands.name: !!kick
commands.description: Kick a member from the server.

commands.name: !!ban
commands.description: Ban a member (or any user ID, even if they left).

commands.name: !!tempban
commands.description: Ban for a while (e.g. 3d). They are unbanned automatically.

commands.name: !!softban
commands.description: Ban and instantly unban: deletes their last 7 days of messages.

commands.name: !!unban
commands.description: Lift a ban.

commands.name: !!purge
commands.description: Bulk-delete recent messages (not older than 14 days, pinned ones are kept).

commands.name: !!slowmode
commands.description: Set a channel’s slowmode (max 6 hours).

commands.name: !!lock
commands.description: Stop @everyone from sending messages in a channel.

commands.name: !!unlock
commands.description: Let @everyone talk in the channel again.

categories.title: Mod tools & setup
categories.intro: Records, automod and settings. Start with `!!modlog #channel` and `!!automod`.

commands.name: !!modhelp
commands.description: Every moderation command, with usage.

commands.name: !!modlog
commands.description: Choose where moderation actions are logged.

commands.name: !!modrole
commands.description: Roles that count as moderators (can warn, mute, purge, lock, slowmode).

commands.name: !!modconfig
commands.description: DM settings and automatic actions at a warning count (e.g. 3 warnings → mute 1h).

commands.name: !!automod
commands.description: Automatic moderation: invites, links, spam, caps, mass mentions, blocked words.

commands.name: !!history
commands.description: Everything moderators did to someone (last 15 cases).

commands.name: !!case
commands.description: Show one moderation case.

commands.name: !!reason
commands.description: Edit the reason of a case.

commands.name: !!nick
commands.description: Change or reset someone’s nickname.

commands.name: !!role
commands.description: Give or take a role.

commands.name: !!userinfo
commands.description: Account age, join date, roles and (for moderators) warnings.

commands.name: !!prefix
commands.description: Show or change this server’s command prefix (Manage Server). !!help always works.

categories.title: Server admin
categories.intro: Manage Server (or equivalent) for most of these.

commands.name: !!poll
commands.description: Starts a poll with 2-10 options, or yes/no if you give none. Add a time like `10m` or `2h` at the start to close it and show results (max 24h). Example: `!!poll 1h Pizza or tacos? | Pizza | Tacos`.

commands.name: !!report
commands.description: Sends a bug or a problem (like a broken command or someone abusing the bot) straight to the bot owner. Your username and server name are included.

commands.name: !!feedback
commands.description: Sends an idea, suggestion, or opinion straight to the bot owner. Your username and server name are included.

commands.name: !!roll
commands.description: Rolls dice. `!!roll` is one d6, `!!roll 2d6+3` rolls two six-sided dice and adds 3, and `!!roll d20` or `!!roll 20` rolls a d20. Max 20 dice and 1000 sides.

commands.name: !!flip
commands.description: Flips a coin.

commands.name: !!choose
commands.description: Picks one of your options at random. Separate them with `|` (or commas). Example: `!!choose pizza | tacos | sushi`.

commands.name: !!donate
commands.description: Support the bot! Donations help keep it running.

categories.title: Server admin
categories.intro: Setup and control commands for server admins.

commands.name: !!settings
commands.description: Server setup for admins (Manage Server): gambling, rob, economy mode (classic|scarce), events and level-up channels, turning commands off, ignored channels, and games-only channels.

commands.name: !!events-channel
commands.description: Picks where I post the Gazette, world events, boss fights, and update notes. Needs Manage Server. Use it with no channel to see the current one, or off to stop.

commands.name: !!levelchannel
commands.description: Picks where level-up messages are posted in this server. Needs Manage Server. Use it with no channel to see the current one, or off to stop them.

commands.name: !!edittitles
commands.description: Admin (Manage Server): manage custom shop titles and optional Discord roles. Built-in items cannot be edited.

commands.name: !!reactionroles
commands.description: Admin (Manage Roles): build role panels with buttons, a dropdown or reactions. Create roles and colors in the builder.

commands.name: !!deletedata
commands.description: Permanently erases ALL of this server's bot data (economy, stocks, pets, settings, everything). Needs Manage Server and a confirmation. This cannot be undone.

commands.name: !!antiraid
commands.description: Join-spike protection, young-account filter, optional soft lock.

commands.name: !!welcome
commands.description: Join message in a channel. Tokens: {user} {server} {membercount}
